title: Add Built‑in Request Validation Middleware
description: Introduce a lightweight validation layer that lets developers define schema objects for query, params, headers, and body. The middleware validates incoming requests against the schema, returns a 400 with detailed errors, and prevents downstream handlers from receiving malformed data, improving security and reducing boilerplate.
testCases: Should pass validation when request matches schema
Should return 400 with error details when any field is missing or of wrong type
Should ignore unknown fields when `allowUnknown` option is false
Should work with async custom validators
acceptance: All new tests pass, existing test suite remains green, validation middleware can be registered via app.useValidation(schema) and correctly blocks invalid requests while allowing valid ones.
reason: Validating input is a common source of bugs and security issues; providing a first‑class, zero‑dependency validator reduces repetitive code, speeds up development, and aligns with the framework's goal of being production‑ready out of the box.
